title: Words Within Two Edits of Dictionary
summary: Given two string arrays, queries and dictionary, each containing words of the same length, identify words in queries that can be transformed into words in dictionary with at most two letter changes.
statement: Given two string arrays, queries and dictionary, each containing words of the same length, identify words in queries that can be transformed into words in dictionary with at most two letter changes. Return the matching words from queries in their original order.
constraints: All query and dictionary words have the same length.
A query qualifies when changing at most two positions can make it equal to at least one dictionary word.
Return qualifying query words in their original order.
hints: Compare every query with each dictionary word position by position.
Count mismatches and accept as soon as one dictionary word differs in at most two positions.
Append once, then stop checking that query.
Changing characters independently costs exactly one per mismatched position, so the mismatch count is the required edit count.
editorial: Changing characters independently costs exactly one per mismatched position, so the mismatch count is the required edit count.

tests.explanation: word differs from wood once, note differs from joke once, and wood matches exactly; ants has more than two differences.
yes differs from yet once, while noo differs in all three positions, so only yes is returned.
